fields.statement: At 36bd98c8 I read the diff: plan.toml (and plan-milestone.toml) change only wait-pr/wait-rebased until and pr-green/rebased-green run to add --reruns 2 to rhiza ship check, with on.pass/on.fail/max_visits unchanged. TestPlanRerunsCIFlakes loads the built-in plan workflows, asserts those four steps carry --reruns 2 with pass routes, no fail route and max_visits 3, and asserts ship-change has at least one ship check step and none carries --reruns. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passed. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/plan-workflow' passed all 8 scripts: plan-workflow-ci-flake (the fake gh fails test (4/5) until two 'run rerun 42 --failed' calls; the run succeeds, gh.log has exactly 2 reruns and 1 pr merge, merge and close-out pass), plan-workflow-ci-flake-red (stays red; the run fails at pr-green, no pr merge, status detail says 'failed: test (4/5) after 2 reruns' and 'the PR changes only .rhiza/'), and plan-workflow-pr still passes.
